name: Light Seafoam
lede: Light Seafoam is a bright, very pale green recorded only in the 2010 xkcd color survey, and its own library entry marks it as close kin to Light Mint.

sections.title: A light build of seafoam
sections.body:
The nearest named colors on file are [[very-light-green]], [[seafoam]], [[aquamarine]] and [[hospital-green]], at 3.4, 3.8, 4.9 and 5.4 ΔE [1]. The ISCC-NBS system classes the hue as very light yellowish green, about 6 units from that block's center, the widest gap of this group [1]. Its Munsell notation is 2.9G 9.2/8.7 and its LCH values are lightness 93, chroma 46, hue 152 degrees, among the lightest, brightest greens in our library [1]. In sRGB its components run 160 red, 254 green and 191 blue, with green at nearly full strength and blue well ahead of red, which gives the swatch its cool, aerated look [1].

See [[seafoam]] for the base sea-foam color this name lightens, and [[very-light-green]] for its closest library neighbor. Further out still, [[greenish-cyan]] sits 5.6 ΔE away, more vivid and darker [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive has a color within CIEDE2000 4 of Light Seafoam covering even 1% of its canvas, as photographed [2]. That describes this archive, not painting as a whole [2].
